scope: Read-only preimplementation design review of original pg-raw.P07; no native run, no source edit and no acceptance promotion.

case.name: native-mask-rule-archive
case.assertion: PostgreSQL Anonymizer SECURITY LABEL masking rules present in the fixture are preserved as native archive, never interpreted as protection or permission; interpretation refuses; the receipt lists the obligation as unverified and the admitted profile is unchanged.

requiredControls.detail: Retain local/shared catalog discriminator, provider, classoid, objoid, native objsubid only where present, and database identity for local rows. Capture both unfiltered catalog populations in one native snapshot; record UTF8 encoding and exact label bytes. Do not collapse equal label text on different objects or conflate absent shared objsubid with a native local zero.

Validate independently authored fixture labels and resolved native object/subobject identities, and separately complete extension-owned populations. Use raw-catalog counts and a retained pre-fixture extension baseline so expected and observed are not both derived from a filtered capture. Missing, duplicate, changed provider/object/subobject/bytes and extra rows must fail correspondence, including an extension-owned row.

Observe actual extension/server/library versions and bytes, loaded settings and per-ordinary-session dynamic masking settings. Keep provider masking disabled and MASKED role examples on separate NOLOGIN fixture roles. Native label masks should differ from the admitted constant0; compare the protected home before labels, after labels, and after archive/refusal. Extension provider validation is excluded setup, not qualified UMF interpretation.

Use the original source serializer, catalog wire inspector and requireProtectionInterpretation in Bun and real Chromium. A valid transforms:[] catalog can carry the opaque native archive without fictional canonical transforms. Assert expected typed refusal, source preservation, complete:false and zero host/native dispatch; setup/import/TypeError failures must not count. A wire-positive baseline prevents vacuous refusal-only evidence.

Report a closed unverified native-archive obligation independently of arbitrary opaque content. Preserve native fields named authority/enforced/trusted, future nested metadata and text exactly while refusing to treat them as grants, transform definitions or satisfied obligations. Changing the report to verified/authority must be detected.

Reuse the unchanged pinned P04 SQL, assert the known initial protected routine/DDL/ACL/role profile, and compare complete selected native metadata and business state before/after each archive/refusal phase. Retain real ordinary SCRAM masked view and direct read/write denials plus excluded canonical100 read and an authorized positive. Label archive preservation does not establish complete Anonymizer callable-route or lifetime security.

Bound complete capture/serialized input under existing source limits and refuse oversize atomically rather than truncate. Preserve exact quotes/whitespace/Unicode/UTF8 across JSON/YAML. Pin image/server/extension/host dependencies, retain failures and verify owned container/anonymous-volume cleanup. Keep original P07 assertion/covers/60s unchanged.

references.supports: Database-local label catalog has objoid/classoid/objsubid/provider/label; column subid is attribute number.
Shared label catalog is cluster-wide and has no objsubid column.
Official registry.gitlab.com/dalibo image; extension may already be initialized; exact digest/version must be observed at runtime.
Dynamic masking activation uses a database setting and MASKED role label; other roles still see original data.
Native masking labels can contain quoted expressions and multiple policy providers; native views/partitions have distinct label behavior.

limits: Image digest cedfa32f762df460091ae5b0f71a96cf21ea6300c51ff1390ea020dded778d8a and runtime extension/build bytes are proposed inputs, not independently qualified by this design review.
No general compiler, dynamic masking enforcement, all-extension callable-route closure, current authority/role/DDL lifetime, or P03/B08 qualification.
No new formal theorem is needed or claimed; actual source/capture/serialization/native correspondence needs executable evidence.
